title: Marketplace Install Request
description: SSOT for the request to DELIVER a catalog listing into an org/workspace once the caller is entitled. Reconcile-not-push: this contract names WHAT (`entry_id` + pinned `source`) and WHERE (`target`) and an idempotency key; the marketplace agent then reconciles the artifact through the EXISTING install engines (plugin reconcile / workspace-template seed / org-template import) rather than pushing bespoke state. Authorization is SEPARATE — entitlement is checked against entitlement.schema.json / the agent's gate BEFORE delivery; this is the delivery-request shape, not the grant. `mode` is const-pinned to `reconcile` (a push-delivery mode would be a deliberate MAJOR change). NO money.

entry_id.description: The catalog entry id being installed (catalog-entry `id`).

source.description: Pinned gitea source-contract string of the immutable ref to install.

version.description: Optional explicit version to install; defaults to the ref pinned in `source`.

mode.description: Delivery mode. Pinned to `reconcile` — delivery reuses the existing reconcile engines (not a push). A push mode would be a deliberate MAJOR change.

requested_by.description: Identity that initiated the install (user id or agent id) — for audit.

idempotency_key.description: Client-supplied key so a re-sent install is deduped to one delivery.

kind.description: Artifact kind. Same SSOT enum as catalog-entry.schema.json.

sourceRef.description: IMMUTABLE gitea source-contract string `gitea://<owner>/<repo>[/<subpath>]#<commit-sha>` — the `#ref` MUST be a FULL resolved commit SHA (40 hex for SHA-1, or 64 hex for SHA-256 repos) — never a short prefix (ambiguous as history grows), branch, or tag, NOT a branch or tag, so the install/authorization target cannot move under the org. The marketplace agent resolves a submitted tag to this SHA.

target.description: Install target. `org_slug` is always required (the owning org); `workspace_id` narrows a plugin/template install to a single workspace (absent = org-scoped, e.g. org-template or org-wide plugin).

org_id.description: Opaque org id (optional; `org_slug` is the stable handle).

workspace_id.description: Target workspace id for a workspace-scoped install (absent = org-scoped).
